name: Bound Souls
body:
School enchantment; Level cleric/oracle 9
Duration 1 year/level

DESCRIPTION

As bound hearts, except of longer duration. In addition, if the two subjects are married, they each receive a +2 morale bonus on Sense Motive checks and Will saving throws when within 60 feet of one another.
